callouts.text: Q1  Estimated clearance: minimum of both tips, 1 decimal, status word + symbol + colour
Trust  Reserved qualifier row: simulation here; live notes use DISPLAYED-level evidence (Critical/Near p10–p90, Clear median bias). Real stream quality telemetry is absent.
Q2  Nearest tip (L / R / L ≈ R) and per-tip depth bars on a square-root scale, tick 0 / 0.5 / 2 / 5 / 10 mm
Q3  Approach trend: last 10 s, same scale and zones as the bars, motion word + rate
Context  Instrument state: jaws open/closed, insertion, shaft angle to retina
Q1 + Q2  Persistent scope, drop line from the nearest tip: tight below 1.5 mm, smoothly wider above; active below 5 mm, off at 5.25 mm
Q1  Scene alarm: frame + banner (Near / Critical), visible without looking at the panel
Q1  Drop line, landing reticle and in-scene label follow the stabilised nearest tip (tie → midpoint); number stays min(L,R).
Q1  Instrument shadow (cast from the tracked light pipe) as a depth cue
Context  Eye globe (12 mm sphere), retina hemisphere, near half cut away
Views  Overview / Surgeon / Sagittal / Fundus presets (keys 1-4)
Views  Display layers (shadow, rays, cutaway, beam, reticle, scope)
Views  Orbit pivot, zoom, reset, shortcut help
Trust  Data source + connection: muted/accent for connecting/waiting/stale; error remains red. Live quality fields are Unknown / —.
